text:
Will Smith's third season in San Jose has been slower on the scoresheet than the second, 13 points in 20 games, but the parts that matter are fine. He is getting 1.24 expected goals per 60 on his own shots, up from 0.96 last season, and he is converting at a normal rate. The problem is the ice around him: the Sharks have scored 6.5 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on, which costs a playmaker points.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 98th percentile of forwards at getting to the home-plate area last season, often off passes across the slot. The weak spot is defense: Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting noticeably more chances with him on the ice, bottom 8% of forwards.

He has talked about the power play's struggles after a loss in Dallas, and it is where a turnaround starts. Our projection lands him around 65 points, and we'd expect the luck to swing his way well before that.
headline: Will Smith is better than his points
